ground_truth.notes: 18-week first marathon plan for a 35 mpw runner with a half PR. Week 1 should be close to current base (35-38mi). Peak week should reach 45-52mi — under-peaking at 35mi will leave him underprepared for 26.2. Long runs must build to at least 18-20mi; this is non-negotiable for marathon prep. Knee concern means easy days matter — plan should include true recovery days. Tempo and marathon-pace work important. 5 sessions/week.
